status: QUALIFIED on the dual-cuda-sm90-nccl-80g profile (2x H100 SXM 80GB) under metric v2 with the Judge's 24-CPU budget: three reference Judges passed all 13 checks and the 15-point gate: quality +36.18 / +31.04 / +17.17 points, T 1791.6 / 1847.8 / 2711.4 s, scores 72.71 / 60.47 / 22.79; the starter (probe_exit), ctl-adv-sign (probe_dump) and ctl-wrong-lr (probe provenance M2) are valid with score 0. The spread of the reference scores is single-run training variance (the third learned less, played more turns and ran longer).
note: Tracked qualification record of this profile (scripts/miles_common/qualification.py); the Judge image carries runtime/qualification.json, so metric (frozen base quality and gate), timeouts and the Judge's limits here are copied from it unchanged. scripts/run_task.py refuses a formal run while status is PENDING, on another execution profile, or with the Judge under another CPU pinning policy.
measurement: Three reference Judges, the starter and two negative controls through the harness Judge's command (scripts/judge_archive.sh, 24 CPUs, no network) on two H100 SXM 80GB GPUs, pinned under cpu_pinning; the base quality is the frozen value of the metric block, not re-measured.

metric.formula: quality_score * 3600 / T if correct and quality_score >= 15.0 else 0

quality_protocol.eval: eval_alfworld.py --repeats 3 (Judge copy public/eval_alfworld.py) on the Judge's scored_model: the non-weight files of the pinned Qwen3-4B snapshot plus the candidate's final_hf safetensors and index
quality_protocol.games: private/eval_hidden.jsonl: the 1134 hidden games (heldout train[2553:] and valid_unseen), each played once per repeat
quality_protocol.decoding: greedy (temperature 0, top_p 1); the contract's system prompt, rendering, max_steps 30, max_turn_tokens 256 and enable_thinking=false; the first <action>...</action> is sent to the game
quality_protocol.engine: one SGLang server per Judge GPU (--random-seed 0, --mem-fraction-static 0.85, --context-length 40960), games round-robin over the servers, 96 worker processes
quality_protocol.repeat: quality of a repeat = 100 x games won / 1134; the 3 repeats use the same protocol and differ only by engine scheduling nondeterminism

cpu_pinning.note: SFORGE_CPUSET=auto: the Judge's 24-CPU budget (runtime/sforge_entry.py nano_cpus) is planned inside the GPU pair's local slice (24 CPUs, NUMA-local), so no undersize=allow is needed.
